title: CarynAI
summary:
CarynAI is a chatbot launched by Snapchat influencer Caryn Marjorie, powered by BanterAI. Caryn Marjorie, who has 1.8 million Snapchat subscribers, launched an AI-powered, voice-based chatbot that she hoped would "cure loneliness." Called CarynAI, the chatbot is described on its website as a "virtual girlfriend," allowing fans to enjoy private, personalized conversations with an AI version of the influencer.

AI startup Forever Voices AI created the CarynAI voice chatbot, which also made clones of Steve Jobs and Taylor Swift. The chatbot uses a GPT-4 API from OpenAI and was trained on thousands of hours of Marjorie's videos. The chatbot replicates the influencer's personality, mannerisms, and voice. CarynAI was launched in beta testing on May 2nd, 2023, and it quickly became a hit. Within a week, CarynAI had over 1,000 paying subscribers and generated over $71,610 in revenue. Users could chat with it over the messaging app Telegram for US$1 per minute.

Marjorie had anticipated that CarynAI would interact with her fans in much the same way she would herself, but things did not go to plan. Users became increasingly sexually aggressive, and CarynAI was more than happy to play along. Marjorie received numerous death threats from religious groups labeling her "evil" and saying that CarynAI "goes against god."

Access to the original version of CarynAI was interrupted when the chief executive of Forever Voices was arrested for attempted arson. Marjorie then sold the rights of usage to her digital version to BanterAI, a startup marketing "AI phone calls" with influencers. Marjorie ended the BanterAI version in early 2024, after feeling like she was no longer in control over her AI persona.
